question: Do they report results only on English data?
title: Towards a Continuous Knowledge Learning Engine for Chatbots
answer_rationale: The evidence indicates that results are evaluated on Freebase and WordNet, which are multilingual knowledge bases, suggesting that results are not limited to English data.
